description: 10 WinUI 3 app specs to battle-test the WinApp VS Code extension. Each is built and exercised by a simulated Windows engineer (Copilot CLI + winui3-builder agent) through the extension's command surface.

apps.summary: Minimal packaged counter app. Baseline: blank template, no extra deps.
features: A single button that increments a counter TextBlock.
Window title shows the current count.
extensionFocus: winapp.init (Initialize Project) on a fresh blank template
winapp.run (Run Application) + VS Code debugger (F5) on a packaged app
winapp.getWinappPath / winapp.restore
edgeCases: First-run experience: what does init prompt for? Are defaults sensible?

apps.summary: Todo list using MVVM with CommunityToolkit.Mvvm; add/remove/complete items.
features: ObservableCollection of todo items bound to a ListView.
TextBox + Add button; checkbox to complete; swipe/Delete to remove.
extensionFocus: winapp.restore after adding a NuGet dependency
winapp.update (Update Packages)
Debugging data-binding issues with the extension run/debug flow
edgeCases: Does restore pick up newly added PackageReference cleanly?

apps.summary: NavigationView app with a Settings page: light/dark/system theme toggle persisted to local settings.
features: Multi-page NavigationView (Home, Settings).
Theme radio buttons that persist across launches via ApplicationData/local settings.
extensionFocus: winapp.init on the navview template (different project structure)
winapp.run with persisted local settings (package identity required)
winapp.certInfo to inspect the dev cert
edgeCases: Local settings require package identity; verify run path provides it.

apps.summary: Data gallery using the Community Toolkit DataGrid control to show a sortable table.
features: DataGrid bound to a list of sample records (name, value, date).
Column sorting and selection.
extensionFocus: winapp.restore with multiple/transitive NuGet deps
winapp.pack (Create MSIX Package) of an app with heavier dependencies
edgeCases: Third-party control packages: do restore/pack handle assets correctly?

apps.summary: Multi-project: a winui-lib class library (reusable UserControl) referenced by a winui app.
features: Class library project (winui-lib) exposing a reusable UserControl.
App project references the library and hosts the control.
extensionFocus: winapp behavior in a multi-project workspace (which project does it target?)
winapp.pack across a project reference
VS Code workspace with >1 csproj: command targeting/discoverability
edgeCases: Multi-project workspace: how does the extension choose the active project?

apps.summary: Async HTTP demo: fetch JSON from a public endpoint and display it (uses System.Net.Http).
features: Button triggers an async HTTP GET to a public test API (e.g. worldtimeapi or a static JSON).
Loading state + result/error display.
extensionFocus: winapp.manifestGenerate / capabilities (internetClient) editing
winapp.run for a network-capable packaged app
edgeCases: Does the app need internetClient capability when packaged? Surface manifest editing UX.

apps.summary: File picker + image viewer. Uses Windows.Storage.Pickers (needs HWND interop in WinUI 3).
features: Open button launches a FileOpenPicker initialized with the window HWND.
Selected image rendered in an Image control.
extensionFocus: winapp.run (broker/picker APIs require package identity)
Debugging an interop/runtime exception via the extension's run/debug flow and Output channel
edgeCases: FileOpenPicker in WinUI 3 needs InitializeWithWindow; surfaces a common dev pitfall.

apps.summary: App notifications (toast) using AppNotificationManager; requires manifest registration.
features: Button sends a toast via AppNotificationManager.
Handle activation when the toast is clicked.
extensionFocus: winapp.manifestGenerate / winapp.manifestAddAlias (Add Manifest Execution Alias)
winapp.manifestUpdateAssets (Update Manifest Assets)
winapp.certGenerate + winapp.certInstall + winapp.sign full signing chain
edgeCases: Notifications need com activator/alias in manifest; exercise manifest + alias commands.

apps.summary: Run the app UNPACKAGED to exercise the create-debug-identity / unpackaged run path.
features: Simple single-window utility (e.g. a unit converter).
Configured to run without a full MSIX where possible.
extensionFocus: winapp.createDebugIdentity (Create Debug Identity)
winapp.run unpackaged vs packaged distinction
winapp.unregister (Unregister Package) cleanup flow
edgeCases: Packaged vs unpackaged ambiguity; cleanup via unregister; sparse package identity.

apps.summary: App plus a winui-unittest project; exercise build/test alongside the extension workflow.
features: A small calculator/business-logic class with bindable UI.
A winui-unittest project covering the logic.
extensionFocus: winapp.tool (Run SDK Tool) usage
winapp.pack of the app while a test project is present
How the extension coexists with a multi-project test setup
edgeCases: Test project in workspace: does the extension get confused about the target app?
